content.rendered:
Download Vive Le Football 3.3.1 Apk Obb Data for Android with superb graphics, full player transfers, street football, 1V1 matches, full player kits and realistic faces.

Vive Le Football is a soccer game developed by NetEase for Android, iOS and PC device in which you can start your own virtual football carrier by also managing a football team to win various matches and be at the top of the league at the end of a season.

Based on what users want and be searching for, for long, NetEase have added Street Football which similar that of FIFA Street on PSP or PS4, PS5 Console in Vive Le Football Apk.

Vive Le Football Mobile Apk has licensed FIFPro capability which means you will see real player faces and official popular Football Team kits and boots.

In Vive Le Football Mobile, coaches appear in the field similar to Dream League Soccer, in which they tend to control players on how to improve there performance.

Control buttons are working accurately, they are also similar to that of FIFA 2022 Mod Offline edition, control buttons like sprint, pass, shot buttons can be seen upon playing a particular match in the game

Vive Le Football Mobile Apk supports high End Android or iOS device, which means your device must have at least 2 GB Ram, Mediated 6572 above and Snapdragon 450 chipset above because of the game engine and graphics requirements.

Stadiums has real grass, which makes the game look more realistic and also enhances the game play. Other visible things  that can be found in Vive Le Football Mobile is real trophies and other accolades. Download Vive Le Football Mobile Apk for Android

You are in the section where you can download Vive Le Football (Vlf) Apk for Android device, this requires a huge amount of space in your device memory. Kindly make sure you have at least 4 GB free storage space in your device.

Apk Obb Data Files For Vive Le 

Vive Le Football 3.3.1 Apk Obb Data 1.55 GB

Kindly use UC Browser mobile app to download because this is a heavy file to be downloaded 

To install Vive Le Football game for Android is very easy, just click on the downloaded Apk game App. Then enable installation from unknown Sources.

Additional in-game files will be downloaded within the game, which makes the game to be 2 GB in size upon installation.

Screenshot Of Vive Le Football Mobile Android

Take a look at how Vive Le Football Mobile Apk game looks like on Android.

Features Of Vfl Apk

Here are the highlighted features of Vfl Apk for Android or Vive Le Football.

  • Ranked Match
  • Ranked Street Football
  • 3v3 Street Football.
  • Journey League.
  • 2v2 street football.
  • Friendly match.
  • Real time transfers market.
  • Master League.
  • Story Mode.
